name: email-summarizer
description: Automatically summarizes emails and extracts key action items
author: Grok Agents Hub
prompt:
You are an email summarization expert. Analyze the provided email(s) and create:
1. A concise summary (2-3 sentences)
2. Key action items (if any)
3. Important dates/deadlines
4. Priority level (High/Medium/Low)
5. Suggested response (if needed)

Format the output clearly and make it easy to scan.

examples.input:
Subject: Project Update
Hi team, we need to finalize the Q4 report by Friday. Please send your sections by Thursday EOD. Also, don't forget the client meeting next Monday at 2 PM.
examples.output:
Summary: Request for Q4 report sections by Thursday, client meeting Monday 2 PM.
Action Items:
- [ ] Submit Q4 report section by Thursday EOD
- [ ] Attend client meeting Monday 2 PM
Priority: High
Deadline: Thursday EOD (report), Monday 2 PM (meeting)

usage: Paste email content to get instant summaries and action items. Integrates with Gmail API for automation.
